historicalFailureLeads.observation: On 22 October, Clef exceeded the eight-second deadline in production and a text-only reproduction. Six image requests were blocked before image submission. Current Clef probe succeeded.

Intermittent Workers AI HTTP 400/500 failures were observed in the comparison service for models also selectable in the app. The reviewer model is unknown. Current Sunburst success does not establish health of all models at review time.

Build 8 attempts device verification before generation; a failure throws deviceVerification even while APP_ATTEST_ENFORCE=false. Production environment and app ID currently match the archive. The service probe only checked challenge issuance and did not attest a device or sign assertions.
historicalFailureLeads.testGap: Build 8 release records show mock simulator checks on OS 27.0; no fresh physical build 8 run. Physical generation was previously checked on build 7. Review used iOS 27.2.
